concept: One hypothetical project update stays on a paper desk while the feedback draft beside it is revised clause by clause. The film makes the next action visible. The colleague's reaction, reply and outcome are never drawn: they stay as empty slots.

motifs.name: paper-turn
motifs.desc: The same paper sheet turns or hands off between stations; fallback is a hard cut or a black narration card.

motifs.name: strip-slot
motifs.desc: The feedback draft is a paper sheet whose strips swap in place; the layout is held and only its state changes.

motifs.name: open-slot
motifs.desc: An empty, unlettered space for reaction, reply, future update, circumstances or follow-up. Never filled.

design.treatment: Slot swap on the held draft sheet: the broad request strip lifts off and the supplied situation and omission strip unfolds in the same place, then a connector draws from its omission span into the gap in the update.
design.why_motion: The swap IS the revision, and the connector shows which part of the update the clause points at.
